leadText:
Up in the Air (Japanese: VS ココロモリ VS Swoobat), titled VS Swoobat in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 494th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 34th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Swoobat (Japanese: 集合 Assembly) in the VIZ Media translation and Up in the Air in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
